rules: Aggregate counts only; do not collect checklist answers
No names, emails, messages, full URLs, query strings, identifiers, fingerprinting or session replay
Count enquiry_accepted only after a server confirms durable acceptance; never on a button click
Internal resource-guide clicks are distinct from verified outbound authority clicks
Visits are not unique people; do not imply otherwise
Document hosting/IP processing, retention, access and lawful basis before activation
Third-party processing and public collection require founder approval
retention_proposal: Daily aggregate counts for 90 days, subject to founder approval; raw event retention off.
